title: Thesis title-page extraction
description: Pivot schema of the VLM title-page extraction for a graduate thesis. Input of POST /check/thesis.

title.description: Main title as it appears on the title page

subtitle.description: Subtitle or remainder of the title, usually following a colon.

author.description: Full name of the author (student) who wrote the graduate thesis

degree_type.description: Academic degree sought by the author. Possible values are Thèse d'État | Thèse de doctorat | Thèse de 3e cycle | Thèse d'université | Thèse de docteur-ingénieur | Thèse d'exercice

discipline.description: Academic field or discipline of the graduate thesis as explicitly mentioned. If not explicitly mentioned, infer it from the title and any other visible contextual elements (this is the only field where inference is allowed). Always return the discipline label in French (e.g. Histoire, Droit public, Sciences de l'éducation).

volume.description: Volume number if the title page explicitly mentions a volume, returned as the Arabic numeral only (e.g. "1" when the page prints Tome 1, TOME PREMIER or vol. I). Null if not explicitly mentioned.

granting_institution.description: Institution where the graduate thesis was submitted and the degree is granted

co_tutelle_institutions.description: List of institutions involved in a joint supervision or co-tutelle agreement.

doctoral_school.description: Doctoral school or graduate program, if explicitly mentioned

defense_year.description: Year the graduate thesis was defended. Format yyyy

advisor.description: List of ONLY persons explicitly identified as graduate thesis advisor/supervisor/director.

jury_president.description: ONLY the person explicitly identified as president/chair of the jury. Null if not explicitly stated.

reviewers.description: List of ONLY official reviewers/rapporteurs explicitly identified as such.

committee_members.description: List of persons explicitly listed as jury or committee members whose role is not explicitly identified as president/chair or reviewer/rapporteur. Include unlabeled persons here.

language.description: Language in ISO 639-3 codes. Example: fre, eng, ita...

confidence.description: Confidence score between 0.0 and 1.0 reflecting certainty based only on explicitly visible evidence on the page
